description:
Each package-graph refusal surfaces as the one graph error type and maps to the profile error code; the command-layer mirror and its field-by-field translator are removed.

## Background

`ProfileDependencyError` (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:262`) mirrors `ProfileGraphError` (`crates/jit/src/profile/graph.rs:215`) through the translator `profile_graph_error` (`profile.rs:2317`). Its fallback arm (`:2372`) sends `SelectedPackageMissing`, `MissingDependency` and four invalid-version variants to the generic error code, because only the mirror is downcast to the profile code (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:144,1276`). Line numbers are at the investigation baseline.

The graph error is pure and stays in the graph module. A dependency loading failure that needs I/O context is at most one command-layer variant, which keeps dependencies pointing inward (`@/inv/architecture-dependency-direction`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The command-layer dependency error mirror and its translator are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each graph error variant maps to the profile error code and exit status, shown by a test over the variants.
- [hard] REQ-03: A dependency loading failure needing I/O context is at most one command-layer error variant.
title: Fold the profile dependency error into the graph error
